home.title: Ratable: real reviews from people who visited
home.description: Verified reviews in Egypt and the Gulf.
home.heading: Real reviews from people who tried it

console.title: Moderation console
console.metaDescription: Review queues and administration for Ratable moderators and admins.

common.network: Cannot reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
common.reasonHelp: Required. The author is shown this.
common.reasonHelpInternal: Required. Kept in the audit log.

errors.wrong_state: Someone has already decided this. The list was refreshed.
errors.content_changed: The author changed this text meanwhile. The newer version is in the queue.
errors.category_mismatch: These two places are in different categories and cannot be merged.
errors.merge_conflict: Cannot merge: the same account reviewed both places. Resolve those reviews first.
errors.file_not_available: The file is not available (already deleted).
errors.cannot_suspend_yourself: You cannot suspend your own account.
errors.cannot_suspend_an_admin: An admin cannot be suspended. Remove the admin role first.
errors.not_anonymous: This item is not anonymous, so there is nothing to look up.
errors.not_found: Nothing was found with that id.

signin.heading: Sign in
signin.intro: For moderators and admins. Sign in with your phone number.
signin.phoneHelp: With the country code, for example +20 10 1234 5678.
signin.codeHelp: The 6-digit code we sent. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
signin.invalid_phone: That does not look like a phone number.
signin.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a little and try again.
signin.code_expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
signin.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new code.
signin.noAccess: This account is not a moderator or admin. Ask an admin for access.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.intro: What is waiting for a person right now.

queue.heading: Reviews and comments
queue.intro: New and edited reviews and comments that need a person. You see the text and why it is here, never who wrote it.
queue.hideTitle: Hide this and tell the author why

aiStatus.deferred: Not checked: the daily AI limit was reached
aiStatus.failed: Not checked: the AI could not be reached

reasons.no_proof_unverified_account: No proof and the phone is not verified, so a person reads it first.
reasons.individual: This is a review of a person (a provider). A person always reads these first.
reasons.ai_deferred: The daily AI limit was reached, so it was not checked.
reasons.ai_unavailable: The AI could not check it.
reasons.abuse: The AI thinks it may be abusive.
reasons.personal_data: The AI thinks it may contain personal data (a phone number, an address, a private person's name).
reasons.spam: The AI thinks it may be spam or advertising.
reasons.suspected_fake: The AI thinks it may be fake or written for the business.
reasons.identifying_details: It is anonymous but may contain details that identify the author.
reasons.copied_text: The same text was posted before.
reasons.review_burst: Many reviews of this place arrived in a short time.
reasons.shared_device_or_network: Several accounts on one device or network reviewed this place.

entities.heading: New places
entities.intro: Places and products people added. Check for duplicates, then approve, reject or merge.
entities.mergeHelp: Its reviews, names and links move to the place you choose. The old link will redirect.

ai.Duplicate: The AI thinks it is a duplicate
ai.New: The AI thinks it is a new place

aiStatus.not_needed: No similar places, so the AI was not asked.
aiStatus.deferred: The AI was not asked: the daily limit was reached.
aiStatus.failed: The AI could not be reached.

proofs.heading: Proofs
proofs.intro: Documents that the automatic checks could not accept, and a random sample of accepted ones that a person also checks.
proofs.everyOpeningLogged: Every time you open a file it is written to the audit log.

reasons.duplicate_file: The same file was used before.
reasons.date_missing: The date could not be read.
reasons.date_in_future: The date is in the future.
reasons.name_mismatch: The place on the document does not match.
reasons.wrong_document_type: It is not the kind of document claimed.
reasons.tampering_suspected: It may be edited or generated.
reasons.sensitive_data_visible: Card, ID, plate or a child's details are not covered.
reasons.low_confidence: The AI was not sure what it read.
reasons.ai_deferred: The daily AI limit was reached.
reasons.ai_unavailable: The AI could not check it.

reports.heading: Reports
reports.intro: Readers reported these. Dismiss them, or hide the item.
reports.hideTitle: Hide and tell the author why
reports.itemGone: The item is no longer available.

disputes.heading: Disputes
disputes.intro: A business disputes a review. It stays visible with an under-review label unless it breaks a rule.
disputes.dismissHint: The review does not break a rule. The label is removed.
disputes.upholdTitle: Hide the review and tell the author why

audit.heading: Audit log
audit.intro: Every removal, decision and look-up, with who did it and why.
audit.actor: Account id of who did it

users.heading: Accounts
users.intro: Roles and suspensions. Phone numbers are never shown.
users.name: Public name
users.rolesNote: Every account keeps the User role.
users.suspendHelp: They are signed out everywhere at once. The reason is kept in the audit log.

ai.heading: AI spend
ai.intro: What the AI service has cost, against the daily cap.

lookup.heading: Author look-up
lookup.intro: See who wrote an anonymous review or comment. Use it only for a legal request or serious abuse.
lookup.warning: Every look-up is written to the audit log with your reason, before anything is shown. If it cannot be logged, nothing is shown.
lookup.id: Id of the review or comment
lookup.reasonHelp: At least 10 characters. For example a case or ticket number and what it is about.
lookup.phoneNote: A phone number is never shown here.
